public_rationale: The papers document some strong neurosymbolic results involving DeepMind and other institutions before June 4, 2024 [e1, e2]. AlphaGeometry combined a neural language model with symbolic deduction; its paper, published January 17, 2024, reported solving 25 of 30 IMO-AG-30 geometry problems, compared with 10 for the previous state of the art and 18 for the strongest enhanced baseline [e1]. NS-CL combined neural perception and parsing with symbolic program execution, with researchers from MIT, Tsinghua, MIT-IBM and DeepMind [e2]. Its paper, available April 26, 2019, reported competitive visual-reasoning performance and better data efficiency than all baselines in its comparison [e2].
limitations: These results concern specific geometry and visual-reasoning benchmarks; they do not establish general intelligence or broad superiority of neurosymbolic approaches [e1, e2].
NS-CL did not outperform every comparator on accuracy: NS-VQA performed better on CLEVR while requiring additional training annotations [e2].
The additional achievement involves a collaboration with institutions outside DeepMind, rather than a project wholly independent of DeepMind [e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: DeepMind and others have achieved strong results with neurosymbolic approaches such as AlphaGeometry.

statement.excerpt: Importantly, DeepMind, among others, has achieved some strong results with neurosymbolic approaches (e.g., AlphaGeometry).
statement.document_title: Open letter responding to Yann LeCun

our_interpretation: 'Strong results' means substantial demonstrated performance relative to relevant prior systems or human benchmarks, not proof of general intelligence.
A neurosymbolic system must combine learned neural components with explicit symbolic representations or reasoning that contribute to its operation.
The claim concerns accumulated achievements by June 4, 2024. No starting date is supplied, so the target period has an open beginning.
'Among others' requires evidence involving another research organization as well as DeepMind. A documented collaboration can satisfy this wording.
The broader context mentions Cicero, but the selected sentence does not require Cicero specifically to establish the claim.
criteria.support_condition: Published architecture descriptions and results establish strong performance by AlphaGeometry and another qualifying project involving researchers outside DeepMind.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The reported systems do not meaningfully combine neural and symbolic methods, or their applicable results fail to show substantial performance and the claimed achievements are materially misstated.
